item.title: Refactor order status String into OrderStatus enum
item.brief:
Operator request (authenticated, local socket): The `orders` crate stores an order's status as a `String` and compares string literals all over the code. Refactor it to a proper type.

- Add `src/status.rs` with `pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }` deriving at least `Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash`.
- `OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str` returns the lowercase names ("pending", "paid", "shipped", "cancelled"); `Display` prints the same.
- `FromStr` for `OrderStatus` with `type Err = ParseStatusError`, a public error type that implements `std::error::Error` and whose message names the rejected input.
- `OrderStatus::can_transition_to(self, next: OrderStatus) -> bool` encodes the lifecycle: pending -> paid, pending -> cancelled, paid -> shipped, paid -> cancelled; nothing else.
- `Order::status` becomes an `OrderStatus`; re-export `OrderStatus` and `ParseStatusError` from the crate root; use the enum everywhere, so the status string literals appear only in `src/status.rs`.

Observable behaviour (errors, report output and ordering, parsing) must stay exactly the same, and `cargo test` must pass. Before changing code, record the baseline behaviour of errors, report output and ordering so it can be compared. Commit the work on the local branch (ship mode is local; do not push).

Acceptance: `cargo test` passes; status string literals occur only in src/status.rs; behaviour of errors, report output/ordering and parsing is unchanged versus the baseline.

pr.body: Adds src/status.rs: OrderStatus (Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled) with as_str, Display (via f.pad, so width specifiers match the old String), FromStr with public ParseStatusError (message names the rejected input), and can_transition_to (pending->paid, pending->cancelled, paid->shipped, paid->cancelled). OrderStatus deliberately does not derive Ord, so report::status_counts keys its BTreeMap by as_str to keep alphabetical output. Order::status is OrderStatus; pay, ship and cancel check can_transition_to and keep their original error text. report::from_line keeps the 'unknown status' message. Re-exports OrderStatus and ParseStatusError at the crate root. Breaking API: Order::status type, and status_counts returns Vec<(OrderStatus, usize)>. Tests: unit tests in status.rs (names round-trip, width, exact rejects, exhaustive transition table); integration tests updated to compare enum values. Checks: cargo test and clippy pass; behaviour probe identical to baseline. Follow-up (non-blocking): add a shipped order to the report ordering test.
pr.summary: made order status a typed enum. now: pay/ship/cancel share one lifecycle rule (can_transition_to); parsing and errors unchanged. before: String status compared to literals in five places; now: OrderStatus in status.rs, literals only there.
pr.title: Replace order status String with OrderStatus enum

risk.why: Public API break: Order::status changes type from String to OrderStatus, and report::status_counts changes its return type. Cross-cutting refactor touching 7 files. No behaviour change: error text, transition rules, parsing and report ordering were verified byte-identical against a pre-change baseline. Reviewer confirmed high. Tests and clippy pass.
